steps.title: Choose the internal AiueOS disk to update. Settings and data are kept.

steps.busy: Verifying the USB update data. The internal disk has not been changed.

steps.title: Update AiueOS. Device identity, Wi-Fi, account, stored data and the previous boot generation are retained. Connect AC power.

steps.busy: Updating from USB. Keep the power connected.

steps.message: Update completed. Remove the USB when restarting. Settings and data are retained.
